title: Release Notes
summary: Added Footprints, LAN sync for local mode, waterfall view, and a writing-mode editor.
Improved sticky notes, login, editing, advanced search, and the feedback channel.
Fixed parent tag statistics and filtering errors.

contents: Footprints can show notes on the map
Local mode now supports LAN sync
Added a writing-mode editor for long-form writing
Improved sticky notes with a toolbar, note management, source display, attachment uploads, and notification reminders
Improved login with an option to ignore certificate validation
Improved editing with support for hiding the voice entry point
Improved advanced search with filters for note source and content identifiers
Unified the feedback channel to a Feishu form
Fixed incorrect parent tag statistics and filtering
